jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the reference garden into a clean BACKGROUND PLATE only. Preserve its warm watercolor style, immense canopy, red brick and plaster boundary wall, front-facing iron gate on left and building sliver far right. Wide 2:1 landscape, camera absolutely perpendicular to the wall. Remove ALL foreground ground platform and front cliff/roots, entry steps, character, lantern and reflector mechanism, broken pots and fragments, giant tail and its stone stair/rubble, exit pot, rays and luminous effects. Fill behind removed items naturally with the existing wall or softly receding garden dirt. The low brick flowerbed remains as fixed scenery at x=15-44% of canvas, its top around y=58%, its lower face to y=87%; small orange flowers and vines. Bottom quarter is a quiet dark mossy-earth scenic strip with NO hard walkable platform edge: later foreground goes on top. There should be ample quiet negative space on lower center/right for separate interactable assets. Put one narrow jagged daylight opening in wall at x=48%, y=33%, bounded by masonry so the light source is identifiable; no light beam painted into the plate. Do not reintroduce any removed foreground objects. Warm, poetic watercolor and delicate dark umber ink, granular paper texture within painted surfaces, terracotta masonry, sage moss and honey sunlight matching reference. Strict front/side elevation for 2D platform game; camera perpendicular to the wall, no isometric view, no 3D toy rendering. No text, labels, UI, arrows, grids or watermark.

Tiny dips/chips acceptable, NO tall bushes or protruding objects. Top surface must be a thin side-on line rather than a broad tilted tabletop. The strip ends vertically at left/right so another could be placed beside it. Nothing on the ground: no character, steps standing on it, lantern, tail, pot, wall, sky, tree or extra props. No detached shadows or painted solid background; genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha all around. Preserve reference materials and restrained warm light. One incoming and one reflected beam, no extra puzzle devices. NO person, black silhouette, humanoid, ruler, arrows or numbers.
